notInApp.title: Open this in the desktop app
notInApp.body: These settings are kept on the computer that runs the Polaris app, so they are changed from inside it.

general.title: General
general.intro: How Polaris starts on this computer.

search.title: Search and shortcuts
search.intro: Polaris search over any app, and the keys that open it.

clipboard.title: Clipboard
clipboard.intro: What Polaris search keeps of what you copy.

voice.title: Voice widget and games
voice.intro: Who is in the call, over your other windows.

hosts.title: Hosts
hosts.intro: The Polaris addresses this app opens.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.intro: How the app draws its windows.

updates.title: Updates
updates.intro: The version of the app on this computer.

openAtLogin.label: Open with the computer
openAtLogin.hint: Polaris opens when you sign in.

startMinimized.label: Start in the tray
startMinimized.hint: Opened with the computer, Polaris waits in the tray. Off, its window opens.

minimizeToTray.label: Minimize to tray
minimizeToTray.hint: Closing the window keeps Polaris running for calls and notifications.

launcher.label: {key} search
launcher.hint: Your shortcut opens Polaris search over any app.

launcherBinding.label: Search shortcut
launcherBinding.hint: The keys that open Polaris search.

launcherGameMode.label: Game mode
launcherGameMode.hint: While you play, or anything is full screen, your shortcut goes to what is in front.

launcherEngine.label: Web search
launcherEngine.hint: Where a web search from Polaris search goes.

launcherClipboard.label: Clipboard history
launcherClipboard.hint: Kept on this computer, encrypted. Passwords from password managers are skipped. Type "clip" to see them.

voiceWidget.label: Show voice widget during calls
voiceWidget.hint: Who is in the call and who is talking. Shift+` in a game, or Ctrl+Shift+`, unlocks it.

voiceWidgetGameOnly.label: Only while a game is running
voiceWidgetGameOnly.hint: Hides the voice widget until Polaris sees a game.

hardwareAcceleration.label: Hardware acceleration
hardwareAcceleration.hint: Uses your graphics card to keep Polaris smooth. Turn it off if windows flicker or go blank.

voiceWidgetAvatars.label: Avatar size
voiceWidgetAvatars.hint: How big each face is drawn.

voiceWidgetNames.label: Show names
voiceWidgetNames.hint: When a name shows beside its face.

voiceWidgetOpacity.label: Opacity
voiceWidgetOpacity.hint: How much of what is behind shows through.

voiceWidgetCorner.label: Position
voiceWidgetCorner.hint: Where the widget starts. Unlock it to drag it anywhere.

shortcut.invalid: Use Ctrl, Alt or Cmd with a key, or a function key.

clipboard.memoryOnly: This computer has no key store, so the history is kept only until Polaris closes.
clipboard.clearHint: Deletes every copy kept on this computer.
clipboard.clearQuestion: Every copy Polaris search kept on this computer is deleted.

restart.pending: Polaris uses the new setting once it restarts.

hosts.manageHint: Add, rename, remove, import or export them in the app's own window.

updates.ready: {version} is ready. Restart to use it.
updates.available: {version} is out. Download it to update.
updates.failed: The check did not finish. Try again.
updates.unsupported: This copy of Polaris updates through the system that installed it.

saveFailed: Polaris could not save this setting. Try again.
unavailable: The app did not answer. Try again in a moment.

intros.general: Notifications, language and Vault on this phone.
intros.hosts: The Polaris addresses this app opens.
intros.updates: The version of the app on this phone.

notifications.label: Notifications
notifications.hint: Which alerts this phone shows, and how.

language.label: Language
language.hint: The app's language, apart from the phone's.

vault.label: Vault autofill
vault.hint: Fill passwords in other apps from Polaris Vault.

browser.label: Open in the browser
browser.hint: This Polaris in the phone's browser.

phone.none: Nothing else to set on this phone.

notHere.title: Only in the desktop app
notHere.body: This category is kept on a computer that runs the Polaris app. The phone app keeps its own under General, Hosts and Updates.
